question: How did the facing of the two principles give rise to the moving and unmoving world?
premises: The moving and unmoving world is fashioned from this.
inference: The interaction of the two principles in manifestation produces the entire moving and unmoving world.
uncertainties: The identity of the two principles (etayoḥ) depends on the immediate context.
plain_english: Through the opened facing of these two, I fashioned the various moving and unmoving world.
